author: Nerdstalgic
description:
What happened to the cancelled sequel to The LEGO Batman Movie? After becoming one of the most beloved superhero comedies ever made, the LEGO Batman universe was supposed to expand into something even bigger: an animated Justice League movie called LEGO Superfriends.

And somehow… it was reportedly inspired by both Boogie Nights and The Godfather Part II.

Seriously.

💬 Do you think LEGO Batman sequel sounded like a good idea? Let us know in the comments!

title: The Insane LEGO Batman Movie We Never Got
